journey.name: Signup — nothing about creating an account needs Pubky Ring
journey.description:
Loopky redeems the signup token itself (9372ff86, #147), so there is no spender to wait for and no install gate: with Ring absent, every method is offered, priced and usable. What used to be checked here — a Ring install block, "Needs Pubky Ring" in place of prices, and a "Create an account in Loopky" link that re-entered the same screen — no longer exists. Ring is offered after the account exists, from the backup menu ("backup_method_ring").
Run it on a device where Ring is not installed, or disable it without removing it (uninstalling destroys the keys of the test accounts on the device): adb shell pm disable-user --user 0 to.pubky.ring

actions.action: From a signed-out Loopky with Ring absent, tap "onboarding_create_pubky"

Verify there is NO Ring install block and NO "Create an account in Loopky" link: the method screen is the only screen, and "signup_method_sms", "signup_method_lightning" and "signup_method_invite" are all present
Verify "signup_method_lightning_price" quotes sats — Homegate was asked, because Loopky can spend the token itself

Verify the fiat figure appears beside the sats one, e.g. "Pay ₿ 10 (≈ US$0.01) once". If the rate lookup fails it must read "Pay ₿ 10 once" with no placeholder and no spinner, and the card must stay tappable either way
Tap "signup_method_invite" and verify the screen moves — nothing on this route depends on Ring

Optionally finish with a real invite code (journey 17), open Profile → back up, and verify "backup_method_ring" ("Export to Pubky Ring") reads "Not installed. We'll take you to it." rather than offering a hand-off that cannot work
If Ring was disabled, restore the device: adb shell pm enable to.pubky.ring
